scripts.clean: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); ['.next','out','dist'].forEach(d => { if(fs.existsSync(d)) fs.rmSync(d, {recursive:true, force:true}); }); console.log('Cleaned build and dev cache.');"
scripts.postbuild: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(fs.existsSync('out')){ fs.rmSync('dist', {recursive:true, force:true}); fs.cpSync('out', 'dist', {recursive: true}); console.log('Successfully prepared dist directory for Render deployment.'); }"
